name: Rigani
sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Rigani is a goddess of the Continental Celts. Her name signified “great queen.” All records of her are unsure. Scholars disagree on whether she was a separate goddess. She may be a title or aspect of Rosmertá. Most texts treat the two names as the same being.

attributes.attribute: may be a title of Rosmerta

okr.objective: Rigani was a Continental Celtic goddess whose name meant great queen.
